# 1 Kings Chapter 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was many days, and-the-word-of YHWH came to-Elijah in-the-third year, saying, "Go, show-yourself to-Ahab, and-I-will-give rain upon the-face-of the-earth."

**2** And-Elijah went to-show-himself to-Ahab. And-the-famine was-severe in-Samaria.

**3** And-Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the-house. And-Obadiah feared YHWH greatly.

**4** And-it-was when-Jezebel cut-off ʾet-the-prophets-of YHWH, and-Obadiah took a-hundred prophets and-hid-them fifty by-fifty in-a-cave, and-provided-them bread and-water.

**5** And-Ahab said to-Obadiah, "Go through-the-land to all the-springs-of water and-to all the-brooks. Perhaps we-will-find grass and-keep-alive horse and-mule, and-not cut-off from-the-livestock."

**6** And-they-divided the-land between-them to-pass-through-it. Ahab went in-one way by-himself, and-Obadiah went in-another way by-himself.

**7** And-Obadiah was on-the-way, and-behold — Elijah came-to-meet-him. And-he-recognized-him and-fell on his-face and-said, "Is-it you, my-lord Elijah?"

**8** And-he-said to-him, "It-is-I. Go, say to-your-lord, 'Behold — Elijah.'"

**9** And-he-said, "What have-I-sinned, that you are-giving ʾet-your-servant into-the-hand-of Ahab to-kill-me?

**10** As-YHWH your-God lives, there-is-no nation or-kingdom where my-lord has-not sent to-seek-you. And-when-they-said, 'He-is-not-here,' he-made the-kingdom and-the-nation swear that they-could-not find-you.

**11** And-now you-say, 'Go, say to-your-lord, "Behold — Elijah."'

**12** And-it-shall-be — I will-go from-you, and-the-Spirit-of YHWH will-carry-you to where I-do-not know. And-I-will-come to-tell Ahab, and-he-will-not find-you, and-he-will-kill-me. And-your-servant has-feared YHWH from-my-youth.

**13** Was-it-not told to-my-lord what I-did when-Jezebel killed ʾet-the-prophets-of YHWH — and-I-hid from-the-prophets-of YHWH a-hundred men, fifty by-fifty in-a-cave, and-provided-them bread and-water?

**14** And-now you-say, 'Go, say to-your-lord, "Behold — Elijah,"' and-he-will-kill-me!"

**15** And-Elijah said, "As-YHWH-of-Hosts lives, before-whom I-stand, today I-will-show-myself to-him."

**16** And-Obadiah went to-meet Ahab and-told-him. And-Ahab went to-meet Elijah.

**17** And-it-was when-Ahab saw ʾet-Elijah, and-Ahab said to-him, "Is-it you, troubler-of Israel?"

**18** And-he-said, "I have-not troubled Israel, but you and-the-house-of your-father, when-you-forsook ʾet-the-commandments-of YHWH and-you-followed the-Baals.

**19** And-now, send, gather to-me all Israel to-Mount Carmel, and-the-prophets-of Baal — four-hundred and-fifty, and-the-prophets-of Asherah — four-hundred, who-eat at-the-table-of Jezebel."

**20** And-Ahab sent among-all the-sons-of Israel and-gathered ʾet-the-prophets to-Mount Carmel.

**21** And-Elijah drew-near to all the-people and-said, "How-long are-you limping on the-two branches? If YHWH is the-God — go after-him. And-if the-Baal — go after-him." And-the-people did-not answer him a-word.

**22** And-Elijah said to the-people, "I alone am-left a-prophet of-YHWH, and-the-prophets-of Baal are four-hundred and-fifty men.

**23** And-let-them-give to-us two bulls. And-let-them-choose for-themselves the-one bull and-cut-it-up and-set-it on the-wood, but-fire they-shall-not set. And-I will-prepare ʾet-the-other bull and-set-it on the-wood, and-fire I-will-not set.

**24** And-you-shall-call on-the-name-of your-god, and-I will-call on-the-name-of YHWH. And-the-God who-answers by-fire — he is the-God." And-all the-people answered and-said, "The-word is-good."

**25** And-Elijah said to-the-prophets-of Baal, "Choose for-yourselves the-one bull and-prepare first, for you are the-many. And-call on-the-name-of your-god, but-fire you-shall-not set."

**26** And-they-took ʾet-the-bull that was-given to-them and-prepared-it, and-called on-the-name-of the-Baal from-the-morning until-the-noon, saying, "O-Baal, answer-us!" But-there-was-no voice and-no-one answering. And-they-limped upon the-altar that was-made.

**27** And-it-was at-the-noon, and-Elijah mocked-them and-said, "Call with-a-loud voice, for he is a-god! Perhaps he is-meditating, or-he-has-gone-aside, or-he-is-on-a-journey. Perhaps he is-sleeping and-must-be-awakened!"

**28** And-they-called with-a-loud voice and-cut-themselves according-to-their-custom with-swords and-with-spears until blood poured-out upon-them.

**29** And-it-was when-the-noon passed, and-they-prophesied until the-time-of the-offering-of the-evening-oblation. But-there-was-no voice and-no-one answering and-no-one paying-attention.

**30** And-Elijah said to all the-people, "Draw-near to-me." And-all the-people drew-near to-him. And-he-repaired ʾet-the-altar-of YHWH that had-been-torn-down.

**31** And-Elijah took twelve stones, according-to-the-number-of the-tribes-of the-sons-of Jacob, to-whom the-word-of YHWH came, saying, "Israel shall-be your-name."

**32** And-he-built with-the-stones an-altar in-the-name-of YHWH. And-he-made a-trench, like-the-capacity-of two seahs-of seed, all-around the-altar.

**33** And-he-arranged ʾet-the-wood and-cut-up ʾet-the-bull and-set-it on the-wood.

**34** And-he-said, "Fill four jars-of water and-pour on-the-burnt-offering and-on the-wood." And-he-said, "Do-it a-second-time," and-they-did-it a-second-time. And-he-said, "Do-it a-third-time," and-they-did-it a-third-time.

**35** And-the-water went all-around the-altar, and-also ʾet-the-trench he-filled with-water.

**36** And-it-was at-the-time-of the-offering-of the-evening-oblation, and-Elijah the-prophet drew-near and-said, "YHWH, God-of Abraham, Isaac, and-Israel, today let-it-be-known that you are God in-Israel, and-I am your-servant, and-by-your-word I-have-done all these things.

**37** Answer-me, YHWH, answer-me, and-this people will-know that you, YHWH, are the-God, and-you have-turned their-heart back."

**38** And-the-fire-of YHWH fell, and-consumed ʾet-the-burnt-offering and-ʾet-the-wood and-ʾet-the-stones and-ʾet-the-dust, and-ʾet-the-water that was in-the-trench it-licked-up.

**39** And-all the-people saw, and-they-fell on their-faces, and-they-said, "YHWH — he is the-God! YHWH — he is the-God!"

**40** And-Elijah said to-them, "Seize ʾet-the-prophets-of Baal; let-not a-man of-them escape!" And-they-seized-them, and-Elijah brought-them-down to the-brook Kishon and-slaughtered-them there.

**41** And-Elijah said to-Ahab, "Go-up, eat and-drink, for there-is the-sound-of the-roar-of rain."

**42** And-Ahab went-up to-eat and-to-drink. And-Elijah went-up to the-top-of Carmel and-crouched-down to-the-ground and-put his-face between his-knees.

**43** And-he-said to-his-servant, "Go-up, please, look toward the-sea." And-he-went-up and-looked and-said, "There-is-nothing." And-he-said, "Return," seven times.

**44** And-it-was at-the-seventh, and-he-said, "Behold, a-small cloud like-a-man's palm is-coming-up from the-sea." And-he-said, "Go-up, say to-Ahab, 'Harness and-go-down, and-let-not the-rain hold-you-back.'"

**45** And-it-was until here and-until there, and-the-heavens grew-dark with-clouds and-wind, and-there-was a-great rain. And-Ahab rode and-went to-Jezreel.

**46** And-the-hand-of YHWH was upon Elijah, and-he-girded his-loins and-ran before Ahab to-the-entrance-of Jezreel.

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **18:21 — "limping on the-two branches" (פֹּסְחִים עַל־שְׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים)**: The verb pasaḥ means to limp, hop, or stagger. Israel hobbles between two options — the same verb used for the Baal prophets' ritual dance in v. 26. Indecision and idolatry share the same gait.

2. **18:27 — "gone-aside" (שִׂיח)**: Often understood as a euphemism for answering a call of nature. Elijah's mockery escalates from theological debate to bathroom humor — the most savage prophetic satire in scripture.

3. **18:31 — twelve stones**: Elijah uses twelve stones — for all twelve tribes — even though the kingdom is divided. His altar declares a theological unity that the political situation denies.

4. **18:38 — the-fire consumed everything**: Not just the offering but the wood, stones, dust, and water. The fire's thoroughness exceeds natural combustion — this is divine fire, not lightning.

5. **18:46 — "ran before Ahab"**: Elijah outruns a chariot — a distance of roughly 17 miles from Carmel to Jezreel. The hand of YHWH enables superhuman physical endurance.

— EMET
